notes: The object lookup 0x7489c (logs its AX index) and the area search 0x5ee80 return a synthetic object/area or 0 per case; 0x8cb60 and 0x56a4c log their tag, 0x577ac its four byte registers and stack code, 0x106b0 AX/EDX/ECX and stack code, 0x10750 EAX/EDX/EBX. Cases vary the active byte +0x18d, flags +0x24, dword +0x12, area owner word +0x10, latch, multiplayer byte 0x127da8, marker, mode 0x12584b, side mirror and grid mode.
